taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Akpoku (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 790.38 | 0.36897 | 0.36897
2 | 1854.8 | 0.8832 | 0.45729
3 | 2133.7 | 3.7316 | 4.1889
4 | 747.1 | 28.838 | 33.027
5 | 1230.6 | 48.108 | 81.135
6 | 2200.9 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Akpoku
Curve type: AKHA
Aquifer depth: 33.03 m – 81.14 m
Recommendation: Target the moderately resistive, thick sand unit (Layer 5, ~1230 Ω·m) between 33 m and 81 m as the main water-bearing zone; ensure proper casing/sealing through the overlying low-resistivity clay/shale layer (Layer 4, 747 Ω·m) to prevent borehole collapse and cross-contamination, and conduct a pumping test to confirm yield and sustainability.
